job_description:
Company

Yarab Technologies (P) Ltd
Module No: 2706, 7th Floor, Yamuna building, Phase-III Campus, Technopark, Kazhakootam, 695581
Website: http://www.yrtechnologies.co.in

Position

Capital & Structuring Manager (Qualified)

Dates

  • Closing Date: 28 Aug 2026
  • Job Published: 24 Aug 2026

Contact

  • Email: jobs@yarabltd.co.uk

Brief Description

We are seeking a qualified capital/finance professional to lead the capital and control workstream for new regulated insurance entities established by the Group — including DFSA, Cayman and Lloyd’s structures. The primary focus is on new entity establishment: defining the capital structure, building the financial control framework, and establishing the regulatory reporting infrastructure from inception. Once entities are operational, you will support their ongoing financial and regulatory requirements, alongside supporting existing entities and reinsurance programmes where required. You will also supervise a junior analyst. This is a build‑focused role for someone comfortable standing things up from scratch, not just running steady‑state reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the financial establishment of new regulated entities (DFSA, Cayman, Lloyd’s and others) – defining opening balance sheet, capital structure and financial control framework, ensuring proper capitalization before business starts.
  • Build capital adequacy and solvency models for each new entity to meet regulator requirements; maintain and update models as the entity grows.
  • Establish the regulatory reporting framework for each jurisdiction (e.g., DFSA, Cayman, Lloyd’s), design reporting pack, set reporting calendar, produce first returns and hand over to ongoing support.
  • Build the three‑statement financial model and entity‑level profit and loss, establishing the management reporting suite for ongoing reporting.
  • Set up the reinsurance programme accounting structure for new entities (quota share, excess of loss, ceding commission), ensuring correct accounting treatment and control framework; support existing programmes as required.
  • Produce the first monthly management accounts and entity‑level reporting pack, establishing format, commentary structure and distribution; support ongoing production for existing entities.
  • Reconcile intercompany balances and positions across group entities.
  • Manage the Group’s Funds at Lloyd’s (FAL) position for the Syndicate in a Box (SIAB) – provide feeds to C&C’s managing agent for annual capital setting (ECM/SBF cycle), optimise FAL composition, respond to Lloyd’s capital calls, maintain FAL headroom analysis.
  • Run capital adequacy stress testing and scenario analysis across the Group’s regulated entities – including shock loss, premium volume growth and FX sensitivity – to assess headroom above SCR/MCR thresholds and inform capital deployment decisions.
  • Manage collateral arrangements supporting the Group’s reinsurance programmes – letters of credit, trust accounts, cash deposits – ensuring collateral is correctly sized, documented and renewed.
  • Own the capital waterfall and inter‑entity funding mechanics – manage dividend upstream, shareholder loan repayment and capital repatriation, ensuring movements are within approved limits and documented.
  • Track and report reinsurance counterparty credit exposure across the Group’s programmes, maintain the counterparty register and flag rating changes, concentration risk or collateral shortfalls.
  • Produce the board‑level capital reporting pack – capital dashboard, solvency headroom by entity, FAL position and stress test outcomes – quarterly or as required.
  • Support existing entities and reinsurance programmes as needed, covering financial control, reporting or capital queries.
  • Supervise and direct the Capital & Structuring Analyst on day‑to‑day work.

Preferred Skills

  • Qualified or finalist accountant (ACCA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent).
  • Experience with capital adequacy and solvency reporting, regulatory returns, and capital stress testing within insurance or reinsurance; familiarity with SCR/MCR frameworks across multiple jurisdictions is an advantage.
  • Hands‑on financial modelling experience, ideally within insurance or reinsurance.
  • Understanding of reinsurance accounting (quota share, excess of loss, ceding commission) and collateral management arrangements (letters of credit, trust accounts).
  • Demonstrable experience setting up financial and reporting infrastructure for regulated entities in DFSA/DIFC, Cayman Islands, Lloyd’s of London; familiarity with Lloyd’s capital processes (FAL management, ECM/SBF cycle, SIAB) is a strong advantage.
  • Strong accounting software skills (Xero) and advanced Excel/modelling ability.
  • Comfortable working independently.
summary: Lead capital and structuring for new regulated insurance entities, building models, reporting frameworks, and overseeing reinsurance accounting. Supervise analyst and manage group capital processes.
